elements.element: On expiry or termination, the post-termination obligations are triggered.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “upon expiration or termination for any reason.”

elements.element: Commerce One must provide transition assistance to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must, “at Corio’s request, provide reasonable transition assistance.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for up to six months.
elements.evidence: The assistance is expressly required “for up to six (6) months.”

elements.element: Transition assistance must be provided at Commerce One’s then-current rates.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly applies “Commerce One’s then-current rates.”

elements.element: Commerce One must return Corio and Customer data to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must “return to Corio all Corio and Customer data in its possession.”

elements.element: The data must be returned within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The return obligation applies “within thirty (30) days.”

elements.element: The data must be returned in a standard machine-readable format.
elements.evidence: The clause requires a “commonly used, machine-readable format,” which satisfies the standard machine-readable-format requirement.

elements.element: Commerce One must delete the returned data after its return.
elements.evidence: Subsection (c) requires Commerce One to “thereafter delete such data from its systems.”

elements.element: Commerce One must certify deletion of the data.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must “certify such deletion in writing.”

elements.element: On expiry or termination, the fallback post-termination obligations are triggered.
elements.evidence: The added language applies “upon expiration or termination for any reason.”

elements.element: Commerce One must provide transition assistance to Corio.
elements.evidence: Commerce One must provide reasonable transition assistance at Corio’s request.

elements.element: Transition assistance must be available for at least 90 days.
elements.evidence: The clause provides assistance for up to six months, exceeding the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Commerce One must export or return Corio and Customer data to Corio.
elements.evidence: The clause requires return of all Corio and Customer data in Commerce One’s possession.

elements.element: The data export or return must occur within 30 days.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly requires return within thirty days.

result.reason: The operative redline fully implements the preferred position and therefore also exceeds the fallback. It identifies the correct parties, trigger, six-month assistance period, pricing basis, 30-day data return, machine-readable format, subsequent deletion, and written certification. The request condition is a reasonable procedural trigger for assistance and does not negate the duty. The changes are confined to transition and data-return obligations and do not disturb the existing survival terms.
